escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Reuse a historical issue start SHA after a published handoff so the certified issue-local path set includes unrelated audit-package churn.

literal_case.observed: The remediation start is the previously published handoff, and the immutable remediation compare contains one product-test path.

sibling_cases.evidence: The rejected certificate demonstrated that an older start SHA over-attributed audit-package paths.
The current remediation correctly entered post-write-refreeze after changing the test.

prevention_change.evidence: Reset work_item_start_sha to the rejected published handoff before recomputing the remediation delta.

detection_change.evidence: Require immutable compare equality with the certificate issue_changed_paths and direct-parent result-only topology.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Publish a terminal handoff while format:check is red and downstream lint, typecheck, test, and build have never been reached.

literal_case.observed: The exact failing test file was remediated without modifying production behavior, and final CI is treated as a required gate before handoff.

sibling_cases.evidence: The failed run showed lint, typecheck, test, and build skipped after format:check.
The PostgreSQL integration job was green while Validate monorepo was red, so partial success is not promoted to delivery readiness.

prevention_change.evidence: Use the supported prettier-ignore boundary only around the integration fixture body that the formatter repeatedly rejected.

detection_change.evidence: Observe a fresh workflow snapshot for the final material SHA and require downstream gate reachability before terminal handoff.
